## 3. Core Competencies & Skills

### 3.1 Frontend Development
- **Languages:** JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5 semantic markup, CSS3 / Modern CSS
- **Frameworks & Libraries:** React.js, Next.js (App Router & Pages Router), Vue.js basics
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS, Vanilla CSS (CSS Variables, Flexbox, Grid), CSS Modules, Styled Components, Material UI, Chakra UI
- **Motion & Graphics:** Framer Motion, GSAP (GreenSock), WebGL / Three.js shaders, CSS Keyframes & Micro-animations
- **Responsive Architecture:** Mobile-first responsive layouts, container queries, accessible ARIA states, progressive web apps (PWAs)

### 3.2 UI/UX Design & Product Design
- **Design Tools:** Figma, FigJam, Adobe XD
- **Capabilities:**
  - User research & information architecture
  - Wireframing & rapid interactive prototyping
  - Complete design systems (color tokens, typography scales, reusable component libraries)
  - Mobile app UI (iOS & Android human interface guidelines)
  - Dashboard & SaaS portal design (dense data grids, charts, analytics views)
  - Landing page conversion optimization & micro-interactions

### 3.3 Backend Engineering & APIs
- **Environments & Runtimes:** Node.js, Bun
- **Frameworks:** Express.js, Nest.js, Fastify
- **Alternative Backends:** PHP (Laravel), Python (Flask, FastAPI basics)
- **API Paradigms:** RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets (Socket.io)
- **Authentication & Security:** JWT (JSON Web Tokens), OAuth 2.0, Passport.js, RBAC (Role-Based Access Control), bcrypt hashing, CORS, rate limiting, data sanitization

### 3.4 Databases & Storage
- **NoSQL:** MongoDB (Mongoose ODM, aggregation pipelines), Redis (caching, pub/sub)
- **Relational / SQL:** PostgreSQL (Prisma, Drizzle, raw SQL), MySQL
- **BaaS & Cloud DBs:** Supabase (PostgreSQL, Row-Level Security, Auth, Realtime), Firebase (Firestore, Firebase Auth, Storage)

### 3.5 Mobile Application Development
- **Cross-Platform:** React Native (Expo & bare workflow), Flutter / Dart
- **Features:** Push notifications, offline caching, native device APIs (camera, geolocation, biometric auth), App Store & Google Play preparation

### 3.6 DevOps, Cloud & Tooling
- **Hosting & Cloud:** AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront), Vercel, Netlify, Railway, Render, DigitalOcean
- **Server Management:** Nginx reverse proxy, PM2 process management, Linux/Ubuntu server setup, SSL (Certbot)
- **Version Control & CI/CD:** Git, GitHub, GitLab, GitHub Actions
- **Payment Gateways:** Stripe, Razorpay, PayPal, LemonSqueezy
- **AI Integrations:** OpenAI API (ChatGPT / GPT-4o), Google Gemini API, Anthropic Claude API, LangChain basics, custom prompt engineering & embeddings
